messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty trigger: service=inference-gateway, urgency=high -> 5xx rate spike in prod-usw2. PD link: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345 :rotating_light:
Samir: Acked. seeing spike on /v1/generate, ~18% 5xx over last 2m. Investigating.
Lenora: I didn't get a push until PD escalated — my phone shows a suppression window. Notified paging config team earlier about 'silent window' behavior.
Maya: I saw the alert but my phone was silent too. Samir, do we have deploys happening in the region?
deploybot: Canary rollout started: inference-runtime 2.4.3 -> 2.4.4; targets: prod-usw2-canary (2 instances) at 20:00 UTC.
Samir: Canary likely correlated. Logs show repeated upstream timeouts from runtime-new to model-pool: "upstream timeout after 10s"
Samir: quick log sample:
```
2026-03-17T20:03:05Z ERROR http_handler.go:212 request_id=abc123 upstream=10.4.5.12:504 timeout
2026-03-17T20:03:06Z ERROR http_handler.go:212 request_id=def456 upstream=10.4.5.13:504 timeout
```
Lenora: That looks like a connection pooling regression in 2.4.4 that leaves sockets hung. Haven't seen this pattern in prior incidents.
Bob: I'm on infra - confirming pool scaling & health. Iraising a temporary pool increase.
Samir: Immediate mitigation: pause the canary and route new traffic away from prod-usw2 canary. Rolling back canary now.
Samir: Commands run:
```
deployctl rollback inference-runtime --canary prod-usw2-canary
redwoodctl route set default-region=us-east-1 --override-prod
redwoodctl scale pool model-pool-usw2 --replicas 6
```
Maya: Routing fallback applied, scale triggered. Watching error rate.
Support Ops: Notifying top 3 customers in affected window; creating CS tickets for errors. Estimated impacted requests ~7% of total in region during spike.
Samir: Error rate dropping to normal within 90s of rollback and routing change. Confirming no data corruption; only increased latency/timeouts.
incidentbot: Incident update: acknowledged by Samir at 7758881236.
Maya: Post-incident checks: run canary in isolated sandbox, add extra connection-safety tests, and add a guard to block canaries with socket-leak patterns.
Lenora: Action items: (1) Pager config: disable 'silent window' suppression for high-urgency inference-gateway PD rules. Owner: Maya. (2) Reproduce connection leak in staging and add regression test. Owner: Lenora. (3) Postmortem doc + timeline. Owner: Samir.
Samir: I'm opening the postmortem ticket INC-12345-PM and tagging infra/runtime/reliability.
Support Ops: Customer notifications sent (CS-9876, CS-9877, CS-9878). No escalations yet.
Bob: Will follow up on deploy pipeline gating to catch socket leak heuristics.
incidentbot: Incident resolved at 7758881289. Closing PD alert. :white_check_mark:
